title: Microsoft-managed Conditional Access policy for high-risk users is now switched on
summary: In tenants with Microsoft Entra ID P2, Microsoft created a managed Conditional Access policy called 'Require risk remediation for high-risk users' in report-only mode in late September 2026. Where admins did not change it, the policy moved to On in the week of 28 October 2026. High-risk users are now required to remediate their risk, for example with a secure password change.
why: A policy you did not create is now enforcing sign-in requirements. Users who are not registered for MFA cannot self-remediate, and emergency access accounts may be in scope.
todo: Open the policy, check its impact data and the security group it uses.
Exclude break-glass accounts and confirm the users in scope can complete MFA.
Decide whether to keep it on or turn it off in favour of your own user-risk policy.
effective_note: Week of 28 October 2026, if left unchanged
